author: ValWood
body:
If more information is required  cdr2 is very specifc 
appears to be fungal specific. It's involved in cell size control and mid1 recruitment to mark the cell division site. Does not appear to be any direct  relationship to  glucose starvation.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
This family contains 1985 sequences, so some over-propagations from one node to another are not unexpected. 
However, in this specific case, cdr2 is clustered with ssp1. Therefore, it is more of a tree topology issue. @huaiyumi ?
I've blocked the annotation for cdr2.
